metadata.title: Micron Stock: 3 Catalysts Set to Boost the Memory Chip Maker Beyond Nvidia Earnings<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
3 Catalysts Set to Boost Micron Stock, Beyond Strong AI Earnings
Micron Technology is moving with the broader artificial-intelligence trade. But for the memory-chip company to really gain momentum, it needs investors warming to its specific story around stock buybacks, long-term supply deals, and custom designs.
